news.body:
## What moved
- The visa route unblocked on Thursday.
Campus France completed the transfer of your Etudes en France file to New Delhi, and the consulate there confirmed it can take your application. The task is now VFS New Delhi, dated 9 November. The TLS Jakarta route is closed and needs no more chasing.
- Business Foundations is paid and closed.
You sent the transfer on Friday with the receipt attached, and Aurore passed the proof to INSEAD's finance team. The module is five days online, 16 to 20 November, which falls in your first full week in India.
- The career block went from empty to nearly finished.
The CV, the post-MBA statement and the CareerGlobe profile all closed on 25 October, and Liesbeth Van Loock was assigned as your coach on Thursday. Booking the first session is the only thing left in that group.

## What did not
- The LMS tutorials, dated 26 October, are still untouched.
- The three remaining internship applications have not moved, and you cleared two others off the board yesterday. The ones left close on 8 November.
- The KITAS closure and the SBI sanction both sit where they were, each waiting on someone else.

## Risks
- The visa is the only thing here with no slack at all.
You cannot file until you are in India, INSEAD's immigration officer puts a long-stay visa at seven to eight weeks, and the programme starts 3 January. Filed in your first week there it lands around the end of December; filed a week later and the top of that range runs past the start date.
- The 53,000 euro instalment falls the day after you fly, and nothing says where it comes from.
It is dated 5 November and the SBI sanction is not dated until the 10th. That gap is the question: whether this instalment is yours to fund or the loan's.
- The KITAS window closes when you leave, not when the task says.
It is dated 8 November, the expiry, but the cancellation and exit permit have to be done in Indonesia and before that date, and you are gone from Wednesday. InCorp's revised quote is still outstanding.

## Put first this week
- Start the tuition transfer Monday or Tuesday.
Wednesday is the flight and Thursday is the date. A transfer begun in transit is one you cannot chase.
- Chase InCorp in those same two days.
It is the only item whose window is geographic rather than a deadline.
- Book the VFS Delhi slot for the days right after you land.
Every week this slips comes off the other end, and the other end is 3 January.
- Then the applications and the coaching session.
Liesbeth's P0 slots open Monday and she wants the CareerPlan Workbook 48 hours before the session. Your questionnaire scores have been done since 18 October, so the workbook is transcription rather than work.
